entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an available agent.
Thanks for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi Sarah. I got an order last week with a new cycling jersey, and it's the wrong size. I need to send it back.
I can certainly help you with that. Just so I'm clear, what specifically is the issue with the jersey? Is it a technical fault or a preference on the fit?
Oh, it's just the fit. I ordered my usual medium, but this model seems to be a bit too tight across the shoulders. I'd like to do an exchange for a large.

Of course, that's no problem at all. Sizing can sometimes be tricky between different cuts. Let me just confirm the policy for you... Okay, I see that our standard apparel, like the jersey, has a 10-day return and exchange window. Since you just received it, you're unfortunately outside that period. I can process that exchange for you right now.

That's great news. I appreciate how easy that is. Now, since I do have to package it up and make a trip to the post office, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next order, just for the inconvenience?

I understand the request, and I'm happy we can get the correct size out to you quickly. While our policy doesn't permit me to offer discount codes for sizing exchanges, I can assure you the process is quite simple. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return label right now, so there will be no cost to you. The moment the carrier scans your return package, we'll ship out the new size.
Okay, a pre-paid label works. As long as I don't have to pay for the return shipping, that's fair. I'll get it sent out this afternoon.
Perfect. The email with the label is on its way to you now. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been very helpful, Sarah.
You're very welcome! Thank you for calling VeloFit, and enjoy your day.
